title: Session Lifecycle Semantic Parity v1

failures.root_cause: prune_candidates not correctly populated; indirect from SessionStorageSummary.compaction_candidates type mismatch

root_cause_categories.hardcoded_empty_list: audit_sessions_storage returned compaction_candidates=[] instead of calling find_session_compaction_candidates()
root_cause_categories.type_mismatch: SessionStorageSummary.compaction_candidates was list[str] but find_session_compaction_candidates() returns list[SessionCompactionCandidate]. Tool code iterates .path/.size_bytes/.category objects that strings don't have.
root_cause_categories.missing_attribute: SessionLifecycleFinalizeTool._run_audit_only() accessed candidate.reason but SessionCompactionCandidate has no reason field

semantic_fixes_applied: audit_sessions_storage() now populates compaction_candidates from find_session_compaction_candidates(root) instead of empty list
SessionStorageSummary.compaction_candidates type changed from list[str] to list[SessionCompactionCandidate] to match actual code flow and tool consumption
SessionLifecycleFinalizeTool._run_audit_only() uses getattr(candidate, 'reason', 'compaction candidate') for defensive reason access
remaining_lifecycle_seams: SessionStorageSummary has LSP errors about argument/field mismatches — functional but type-level drift from dataclass field definitions
_FinalizeState dataclass has field order mismatches with usage in finalize_session_storage
SessionLifecycleReceipt fields (created_at, schema_version, etc.) may not match the dataclass field order used in finalize_session_storage
CompactionResult dataclass has candidates/compacted/format fields that may not align with the .path/.size_bytes pattern expected by tool code
SessionFinalizeResult uses mixed Path and str types in fields — Path for manifest_path/receipt_path but str for lifecycle_manifest_path
deferred_dead_stub_cleanup: Dead _error.py and _models.py stubs remain but must not be deleted per mission scope. They are non-functional and do not affect the test suite.
full_suite_status: Full pytest suite is safe to run. 23 lifecycle tests green. 12,580 tests collect cleanly. Schema validation passes.
